name: marketplace-agreement
description: AWS Marketplace is a curated digital catalog that customers can use to find, buy, deploy, and manage third-party software, data, and services to build solutions and run their businesses.

subcommands.name: accept-agreement-cancellation-request
subcommands.description: Allows buyers (acceptors) to accept a cancellation request that is in PENDING_APPROVAL status.

subcommands.name: accept-agreement-payment-request
subcommands.description: Allows buyers (acceptors) to accept a payment request that is in PENDING_APPROVAL status.

subcommands.name: accept-agreement-request
subcommands.description: Accepts an agreement request to finalize the agreement.

subcommands.name: batch-create-billing-adjustment-request
subcommands.description: Allows sellers (proposers) to submit billing adjustment requests for one or more invoices within an agreement.

subcommands.name: cancel-agreement
subcommands.description: Allows an acceptor to cancel an active agreement.

subcommands.name: cancel-agreement-cancellation-request
subcommands.description: Allows sellers (proposers) to withdraw an existing agreement cancellation request that is in a pending state.

subcommands.name: cancel-agreement-payment-request
subcommands.description: Allows sellers (proposers) to cancel a payment request that is in PENDING_APPROVAL status.

subcommands.name: create-agreement-request
subcommands.description: Creates an agreement request that acts as a quote for the terms you want to accept.

subcommands.name: describe-agreement
subcommands.description: Provides details about an agreement, such as the proposer, acceptor, start date, and end date.

subcommands.name: get-agreement-cancellation-request
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific agreement cancellation request.

subcommands.name: get-agreement-entitlements
subcommands.description: Obtains details about the entitlements of an agreement.

subcommands.name: get-agreement-payment-request
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific payment request.

subcommands.name: get-agreement-terms
subcommands.description: Obtains details about the terms in an agreement that you participated in as proposer or acceptor.

subcommands.name: get-billing-adjustment-request
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific billing adjustment request.

subcommands.name: list-agreement-cancellation-requests
subcommands.description: Lists agreement cancellation requests available to you as a seller or buyer.

subcommands.name: list-agreement-charges
subcommands.description: Allows acceptors to view charges and purchase orders that are associated with an agreement.

subcommands.name: list-agreement-invoice-line-items
subcommands.description: Allows sellers (proposers) to retrieve aggregated billing data from AWS Marketplace agreements using flexible grouping.

subcommands.name: list-agreement-payment-requests
subcommands.description: Lists payment requests available to you as a seller or buyer.

subcommands.name: list-billing-adjustment-requests
subcommands.description: Lists billing adjustment requests for a specific agreement.

subcommands.name: reject-agreement-cancellation-request
subcommands.description: Allows buyers (acceptors) to reject a cancellation request that is in PENDING_APPROVAL status.

subcommands.name: reject-agreement-payment-request
subcommands.description: Allows buyers (acceptors) to reject a payment request that is in PENDING_APPROVAL status.

subcommands.name: search-agreements
subcommands.description: Searches across all agreements that a proposer or an acceptor has in AWS Marketplace.

subcommands.name: send-agreement-cancellation-request
subcommands.description: Allows sellers (proposers) to submit a cancellation request for an active agreement.

subcommands.name: send-agreement-payment-request
subcommands.description: Allows sellers (proposers) to submit a payment request to buyers (acceptors) for a specific charge amount for an agreement that includes a VariablePaymentTerm.

subcommands.name: update-purchase-orders
subcommands.description: Allows acceptors to associate purchase orders with agreement charges after an agreement is created.
